name: forge
description: Make Roblox games from an idea and keep improving them: Forge designs, codes and playtests in Roblox Studio, an auditor finds anomalies, the fixer repairs them and a verifier keeps or rolls back each fix. Every LLM call goes through Mubit, so corrections become model updates.

mubit_api_key.title: Mubit API key
mubit_api_key.description: Your mbt_ key from https://app.mubit.ai/console/ (Mubit keys). Leave empty to use MUBIT_API_KEY from the checkout's .env.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id sent through Mubit. Keep it the same for the whole team so tasks pool. The starter credit serves claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5 and claude-haiku-4-5.

project_dir.title: mubithack checkout
project_dir.description: Path to your clone of chocoliticekreem/mubithack (where games are saved under runs/). Leave empty to use the current project or the marketplace copy.
